description: This source file defines an interface for managing product relationships within an e-commerce system, including methods for saving, retrieving, grouping, and updating product relationship data.

classes.name: ProductRelationshipService
classes.description: An interface providing services to manage product relationships, including retrieval, grouping, creation, and state management.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a given product relationship, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product relationships filtered by store, product, type, and optionally language.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Lists all product relationships for a given product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Retrieves product relationship groups within a store.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new relationship group within a store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships belonging to a specific group within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a specified group from the store.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates a specified group within the store.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Activates a specified group within the store.
